fact: Car 24 left the track at T15 and gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code and Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, timing and in-car video evidence. Car 24 tried to overtake Car 20 on the inside into Turn 15, but was not able to complete the overtaking maneuver on track, left the track and gained a lasting advantage. The Stewards noted that Car 20 also went off track at the same time, but determined that this was a result of Car 24 preventing Car 20 from turning in.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 24 Leaving The Track
to: The Team Manager, Alfa Romeo F1 Team Stake
